main_text.p: Gemitus, Suspiria, ad Roman.8.26. Act.7.34. ad Hebr.13.17.
אונכא Ch. Onyx, ὄνυξ, lapis pretiosus. Plural. אונכין Numer.33.8. in Jon.
אנן Hebr. Plangere, Lugere, Moestum esse. Hinc Ch. Partic. אנן Luget, Eccles.7.4.
אנינותא Ch.Lamentum, luctus, Moestitia, dolor, Jobi 18.12. Threm.2.5.

אננקי Chal. ܐܢܢܩܐ Syr. Graec. ἀνάγκη, Necessarium, necesitas: Anguftia, prefsio, opprefsio, calamitas, afflictio. Occurrit in Targ. Jonath. & Hierof. saepius, & pro eo saepe est אניקי: Aliter ܟܢܢܩܐ In necesitate, ad imitationem Graeci ἐν ἀνάγκαις, 2.ad Corinth.6.5.

אנס Ch. Coegit, adegit, Urfit, prefsit, vim, violentiam intulit, violenter rapuit, diripuit, opprefsit. Ithpeh. Chald. אתאנס Idem. Semel Syr. in Ethp. ܐܢܣ Coactus est, ad Galat.2.3. Aphel Fut. לא תוניסון Non opprimatis, Jerem.7.6.
אונס, אונסא, אונסא Vis, violentia, rapina, coactio, opprefsio. Plur. אונסין, Jesa.5.11.
אונס, אונוס, אונס, אנס Ch.Violentus: Dominus, dominator, Tyrannus, vim ac potestatem alios cogendi habens. Sunt qui derivant ab Hebraeo און, Robur, Potentia. Plur. אנוסיא, אנוסין.

page.notes: Greek and Hebrew words are rendered as closely as the scan allows; several Hebrew/Syriac forms with vowel points are approximate and marked as doubtful where unclear. Syriac line "ܐܢܢܩܐ" and "ܟܢܢܩܐ" are uncertain.
